FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Bridal Bliss Boutique, we specialize in providing a personalized experience for brides-to-be, focusing on an extensive selection of wedding gowns, bridesmaid dresses, and accessories. Our operations include individual consultations and fittings, allowing us to tailor each experience to the unique needs of our clients. We maintain strong relationships with reputable suppliers to ensure timely delivery of high-quality products. To protect our clients' information, we have implemented robust cybersecurity controls, including secure payment processing and data encryption, safeguarding against potential cyber threats. Our team participates in regular training on data privacy and customer service best practices, ensuring a knowledgeable and prepared staff.

Our bridal shop operates by processing payments through an online system that does not currently incorporate documented cybersecurity measures such as data encryption or secure payment processing, as we focus primarily on enhancing customer experience and convenience.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: No losses reported. The shop maintains strong cybersecurity controls; however, it lacks a tested incident response plan for cyber events, which may compromise risk management and insurability.
